attacks.summary: Repeated Russian UAV attacks hit Kyiv during 11 September, including residential, fuel-station and non-residential locations. The official city timeline confirmed two deaths and at least 12 affected people by mid-afternoon; later reporting described 16 affected overall.

sources.note: Official timeline confirms two deaths and 12 affected people by 14:46; later evening impacts are also documented.
Later report says 16 people were affected overall and two died; retained as a clarification without inferring an exact later injured-only total.

sourceLocation.text: Multiple Kyiv districts, including Dniprovskyi, Obolonskyi and Podilskyi

incidents.summary: The city timeline recorded UAV impacts and debris affecting a residential building, fuel stations, an office/non-residential building, nearby warehouse property and vehicles. Repeated impacts occurred during the day. Exact recent strike points are intentionally not mapped.

damage.description: Residential, fuel-station, office/warehouse and vehicle damage was reported across multiple districts.
